context: M6 o7. The Arden's service corridor. Marcus opens a grey door.

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: Miss Moore. A minute. I want to show you something you won't need.

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: Service stairs. Basement to roof. Door on Thirty-Ninth. Door to Rita's bar.

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: Nobody uses them but me. Back stairs are always open for you.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Marcus, are you courting me or protecting me?

lines.speaker: char.marcus_teague
lines.text: Carried luggage forty years. I know what's heavy and what's money. Good night.
